observer: Claude (Opus 5.5), 9 Nov 2026: the raw scan (1841 x 2242) blurred 3x3, whole with a 0.05 grid and four crops at 0.02; read for the floor's and wall's shape, not against a render
covers: the left wall's foot and the deck beside GA-3's pedestal, seen from about seated height: the rack's foot, the skirt, the raised ledge with its bosses, the deck, the olive plate, the holed pedestal and the pylon's foot
notes: session A (9A33BM2/BM3, not identified). The camera looks at the left wall, photo right is forward. The same floor as g100-d from lower and further forward; features are cross-referenced by detail. The pylon at the right edge is a big vertical drum with a flared foot; g097-b's left-hand drum is probably the same one.

details.what: the wall's plain lower skirt below the rack's white foot block: flat grey sheet from the block's underside to the ledge, about the height of the GA-3 dome's lower two-thirds
details.size_cue: about as tall as the handrail's clear height below the pipe

details.what: the rack's foot: a white block along the wall's base, its lower edge a straight line above the skirt
the skirt's foot on the ledge: a straight line under the clipped cable, a grimy strip along it
three round bosses in the ledge's top, hex bolts in raised rings
details.size_cue: each about as wide as the handrail's foot plate

details.what: the ledge's inboard edge, a bright bent rim dropping to the deck, running aft out of the frame down and to the left
details.size_cue: the ledge about two handrail foot-plates wide

details.what: a rectangular pressed patch in the ledge, stippled, its long sides running across the vehicle
a dark diagonal crease at the ledge's aft end, the head of the slope
the olive-brown plate on the deck in front of the pedestal, its aft corner rounded
a bright turned-up strip on the deck at the plate's aft side
two small rivets and two flange bolts at the plate's corners
three of the round floor cover's flange bolts
the dark line round the floor cover's outer edge, from the bolt along the cover's rim and out of the frame
GA-3's pedestal: a sheet-metal frustum standing on the plate, narrowing to the deck, a big round lightening hole in the face toward the camera and two more down its aft face
details.size_cue: the big hole about as wide as the dome's lower flange is deep

details.what: the pylon's foot at the right edge: a big vertical drum, its flared flange coming down in a curve to the deck
details.size_cue: the drum wider than the frame shows; its flange about a handrail's foot-plate deep
details.note: g097-b d12 probably shows the same foot; g099-b does not

details.what: the pylon's lit body, a plain vertical drum standing clear of the rack
the dark gap between rack and pylon: a recess in the wall where the rack ends, with a stepped upright edge and ribbing
the bent tube handrail round GA-3 with its flat foot plates on the deck (a short mention)
